book.name: Matei
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Matei

content: Unyagho gwa kulyegha gwa kutolana
Yecho ajhakulonge nabho kabhele kwa milandanikiho,
“Unahota gwa Chapanga ulandine na nkolo jwakanenganikiye mwana mundo unyagho gwa kutolana.
Jwenio ajhakwatuma akatumiche bhake bhakakeme bhibhalalike bhala bhahike, nambo bhene bhajhakubhehe mbe kuhika.

Peniya ajhakwatuma akatumiche bhange, ajhakwalobholela alongila, ‘Mwalongolele bhando bhinalalike kubhehe unyagho ubhii lengalenga ngohe. Lipongo lya ng'ombi na matohe gha ng'ombi ghighahatite njinjite, kila kilebhe kibhii telatela, nhwike ngane pa unyagho!’
Nambo bhene bhakachitwike ndeka, kila jhumo ajhakujhenda kwakumanyite, jhumo kunghonda na jhonge kwachuluchila ilebhe yake,
na bhange bhajhakwakamula akatumiche na kwatyala na kwakoma.
Munahota nkolongwa jhola ajhakuchimwa, ajhakwatuma akomana ngondo bhake. Bhakwakomelekeya bhubhakoma bhala na kuchonja muche gwabhe kwa mwotu.
Peniya ajhakwalobholela akatumiche bhake, ‘Chakulya cha unyagho gwa kutolana ngoheno ubhii lengalenga, nambo bhinalalike bhakatopi ndeka kuhika.
Bhahe, nnyendengane mundela na jhojhoha jhola jhumipala kummona munete paunyagho gwa kutolana pano.’
Akatumiche bhala bhajhakujhenda mundela, bhajhakwakema bhoha bhubhakongina nabho, bhambone na bhanganandela, na nyumba jhene ijhakuhindamana ndi akaghene.
“Munahota nkolongwa pajhingila kwalolekeya akaghene, ajhakummona mundo jhumo akahwalite ndeka ngobho ya unyagho gwenio.
Munahota jhola ajhakunkonya, ‘Mwakoche, nhwalo gwa nike nnyingii mombo changa ngobho ya unyagho gwa kutolana?’ Jwenio ajhakubhehe nuu.
Peniya munahota nkolongwa jhola ajhakwalobholela akatumiche bhake, ‘Mutabhe magholo na mabhoko na mukataghii kulubhendo. Kwenio nalela na kuyagha mino.’ ”
Peniya Yecho ajhakulonge, “Bhando bhunkemitwe bhamahele, nambo bhala bhibhahagwile ndi bhandina.”
Kulepa kode kwa munahota jwa ku Loma
Peniya Mapwalichayo bhajhakubhoka na bhajhakulenganikila ndela jha kunyonja Yecho mu malobhe ghake.

Bhahe, Mapwalichayo bhajhakwatuma bhabholwa bhake pamonga bhabholwa bha kikunde cha Helode kwa Yecho. Bhajhakunkonya Yecho, “Mmola, tumanya mwenga ndi mundo jwa chakaka, na mibhola mabholo gha chakaka gha ndela jha Chapanga. Changannolekeya mundo kumiho helahela muloloke jhe hilu ukolo gwa mundo jhojhoha.
Ngoheno mutulobholele, bhole yamaha amu yamaha ndeka kulepa kode kwa munahota nkolongwa jwa ku Loma liina lyake Kaichale?”
Nambo Yecho akamanye ndela jhabhe jhanganandela, ajhakwajhanguu, “Mangota mukitenda bhando bhaumbone, Bho, munyighanikiya nhwalo gwa nike?
Unangiye hote mbijha jhene jhimulepe kode.” Na bhene bhajhakunangiya litobholo lya mbijha.
Bhahe, Yecho ajhakwakonya, “Bho, chula jhenje na liina lilijhandikwe leno lya ghane?”
Bhajhakunyanguu, “Ndi lya munahota nkolongwa jwa ku Loma.” Yecho ajhakwalobholela, munahota nkolongwa jwa ku Loma mupele jwenio na ghughabhii gha Chapanga mupele jwenio Chapanga.
Pubhajhohina malobhe gheniya bhajhakukangachwa nako, bhajhakuneka, “Yecho na bhajhakubhoka peniya.”
Libholo lya kuyoka
Lichiko lele Machadukayo bhange bhibhalonge bhubhawile bhayoka jhe, bhajhakunyendelela Yecho,
bhajhakunkonya, “Mmola, Mucha akalongi, mundo jwatolile anda awile changaneka yana, nhwacha mundo ipalwa amujhila majhe jwenio lipwela apapila yana nnongo mundo jwawile.
Bhahe, pamba pito pakibha akalongo chaba. Jwakutumbula ajhakutolela na kuwegha changaleka mwana. Na nnongo mundo ajhakubhujhila lipwela lyenio,
Ijakubhehe hele kwa nnongo mundo jhubhele na jwa utato, ade jhola jwa chaba.
Bhakawii bhoha chaba, na mwikeghe jhola ajhakuwegha hele.
Bho, lichiko lya bhando lya kuyokechwa, mwikeghe jwenio nabhaha nhwana gwa ghane, nhwalo bhoha chaba bhakantolile?”
Yecho ajhakwajhanguu, “Mangota ntei kulemwa nhwalo gwangamanya Majhandiko gha Chapanga hilu likakala lya Chapanga.
Nhwalo bhando pubhapala kuyokechwa kuhumii kubhawile kutolela amu kutolelwa kubhii jhe, nabhabha ngita akatumiche bha kunane kwa Chapanga.
Na panane jha kuyokechwa kwa bhubhawile, bho, nchomite jhe malobhe ghannobholila na Chapanga?
‘Nenga na Chapanga jwa Ulahimo na Chapanga jwa Isaka na Chapanga jwa Yakobu.’ Yecho pajhendelila kwalobholela, jwenio chi Chapanga jwa bhando bhubhawile nambo Chapanga jwa bhando bhubhabhii ghome.”
Lilongo lya bhando ghola pubhajhohina mabholo gheniya, bhajhakuhechuka hake.
Lilaghilo likolongwa
Peniya Mapwalichayo pubhajhohina Yecho ajhakwahibha milomo Machadukayo, bhajhakukonganika pamonga.
Na jhumo jwa bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo, jwakibha mundo jwakaimanye Malaghalikilo mbone ajhakunyendelela Yecho na kunkonya kwa kunyighanikiya,
“Mmola,” “Lilaghilo ghane likolongwa mu Malaghalikilo ghoha?”
Yecho ajhakujhanguu, “ ‘Mupale Bhambo Chapanga kwa mwojho gwii ghoha, na kwa uhuke gwii ghoha na malango ghii ghoha.’
Lende ndi lilaghilo likolongwa na lya kutumbula.
Chubhele ilandana na lende, ‘Mupale nnyino ngita chimukipala mabhene.’
Malaghalikilo ghoha gha Chapanga ghapekiwe Mucha na mabholo ghoha gha milondole bha Chapanga ghahobholela mihilo jhenje mibhele.”
Kilichitu Nkomboche ndi Mwana gwa ghane
Peniya Mapwalichayo pubhakonganika pamonga, Yecho ajhakwakonya,
“Mangota miwacha bho panane jha Kilichitu Nkomboche? Bho, Jwenio ndi mwana jwa ghane?” Na bhene bhajhakunyanguu, “Jwenio ndi Mwana gwa Daude.”
Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Peniya nhwalo gwa nike kwa likakala lya Uhuke gwa Chapanga Daude ankemi jwenio ‘Bhambo?’ Ndi nhwalo akalongi,

content.text: ade nabheke akamakoko bhino pahe jha magholo ghino.’

content: Bhahe, anda Daude ankema Kilichitu Nkomboche, ‘Bhambo,’ ahoto bhole kubhehe mwana mundo?”
Bhahe, abhii jhe mundo jhojhoha jwakahotwii kujhanguu lilobhe. Kuhumii lichiko lyenio Na bhene bhakajhighite jhe kunkonya machwale ghange.
